title: PHASE2 — Achiri Hetzner deployment script for Apr 25 alpha
rationale: Achiri alpha is April 25 (31 days). Achiri state: all T3 skills done, voice validated 10/10. Next mandatory step per Achiri master plan = Hetzner deployment for public URL. Currently achiri-api runs only on Mac Mini (port 3420). Need (1) deploy-hetzner.sh to rsync agents/achiri + ecosystem config to Hetzner VPS and restart PM2 achiri-api there; (2) nginx config snippet for reverse proxy to port 3420. Both files under 150 lines, stdlib-only, no swarm deps.

tasks.description: Create scripts/achiri/deploy-hetzner.sh. Bash script that: (1) reads HETZNER_HOST (default: 65.108.90.178), HETZNER_USER (default: root), HETZNER_KOGNAI_PATH (default: /home/kognai/kognai); (2) runs rsync -avz --delete agents/achiri/ to Hetzner; (3) rsyncs kognai-agents/achiri/; (4) rsyncs tsconfig.scripts.json and package.json; (5) SSHs to Hetzner and runs: cd $HETZNER_KOGNAI_PATH && npm ci --production && pm2 restart achiri-api || pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only achiri-api; (6) tails last 10 lines of pm2 log for confirmation. Supports --dry-run flag (default: dry-run like publish-all.sh pattern). Use only stdlib (bash). No external deps.

Create scripts/achiri/nginx-achiri.conf. Nginx server block config for proxying api.achiri.app (or configurable SERVER_NAME) → localhost:3420 (achiri-api). Include: listen 80, location / proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3420, proxy headers (Host, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Proto), proxy_read_timeout 60s, client_max_body_size 1m. Add comment block at top: usage instructions (copy to /etc/nginx/sites-available/achiri, symlink to sites-enabled, certbot for HTTPS). Static file, no compilation needed.

acceptance_criteria: scripts/achiri/deploy-hetzner.sh exists, is executable (chmod +x), runs in dry-run mode without errors
scripts/achiri/nginx-achiri.conf exists and contains valid nginx server block with proxy_pass to 3420
